_comment: Card Wallet header options - the top-bar buttons and the dropdowns they open.
Edit this file, then: python3 repo_export/patches/patch8_header_options.py && python3 repo_export/patches/build_debug_apk.py
chip: true = filled disc (bg + contrasting glyph), false = bare glyph on the page - the reference picture has only the + on a disc
tone: 'black' (#000, as drawn in the picture) | 'white' | 'ink' (follows the theme: black on light, white on dark - use this if bare black glyphs vanish on the dark pouch)
icons: plus, search, bars, dots-v, dots-h, gear, image, camera, nfc, trash, x, check, chevron-r, wallet, sliders, list, star, card, eye, share, lock
actions: toggle:<add|more>, gallery, camera, nfc, search, settings, studio, delete, none
when: 'nfc' (device has NFC) or 'hasCards' (something to delete) - gates the app already has
showText: true puts the label next to the icon and the chip grows to fit
